name: Nat
totient
result.informal_description: The function that maps a natural number $ n $ to the cardinality of the set $ \{ a \in \{0, 1, \dots, n-1\} \mid \gcd(a, n) = 1 \} $, i.e., the count of integers between $ 0 $ and $ n-1 $ that are coprime with $ n $.

name: Nat
totient_dvd_of_dvd
result.signature: {a b : ℕ} (h : a ∣ b) : φ a ∣ φ b
result.type: ∀ {a b : ℕ}, a ∣ b → a.totient ∣ b.totient
result.value:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha0)
  · simp [zero_dvd_iff.1 h]
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | hb0)
  · simp
  have hab' := primeFactors_mono h hb0
  rw [totient_eq_prod_factorization ha0, totient_eq_prod_factorization hb0]
  refine Finsupp.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset_of_dvd hab' fun p _ => mul_dvd_mul ?_ dvd_rfl
  exact pow_dvd_pow p (tsub_le_tsub_right ((factorization_le_iff_dvd ha0 hb0).2 h p) 1)
result.informal_description: For any natural numbers $a$ and $b$, if $a$ divides $b$, then Euler's totient function evaluated at $a$ divides that evaluated at $b$, i.e., $a \mid b$ implies $\varphi(a) \mid \varphi(b)$.

name: Nat
totient_super_multiplicative
result.signature: (a b : ℕ) : φ a * φ b ≤ φ (a * b)
result.value:
:= by
  let d := a.gcd b
  rcases (zero_le a).eq_or_lt with (rfl | ha0)
  · simp
  have hd0 : 0 < d := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ ha0
  apply le_of_mul_le_mul_right _ hd0
  grw [← totient_gcd_mul_totient_mul a b, mul_comm, d.totient_le]
result.informal_description: For any natural numbers $a$ and $b$, the product of their Euler totient values satisfies $\varphi(a) \cdot \varphi(b) \leq \varphi(ab)$.

name: Nat
totient_le
result.informal_name: Euler's Totient Function is Bounded by n
result.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $, Euler's totient function $ \phi(n) $ satisfies $ \phi(n) \leq n $.

name: Nat
totient_mul_of_prime_of_dvd
result.signature: {p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (h : p ∣ n) : (p * n).totient = p * n.totient
result.type: ∀ {p n : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n → (p * n).totient = p * n.totient
result.value:
:= by
  have h1 := totient_gcd_mul_totient_mul p n
  rw [gcd_eq_left h, mul_assoc] at h1
  simpa [(totient_pos.2 hp.pos).ne', mul_comm] using h1
result.informal_name: Euler's Totient Function Scales by Prime When Dividing
result.informal_description: For a prime number $ p $ and a natural number $ n $ such that $ p $ divides $ n $, the Euler's totient function satisfies $ \varphi(pn) = p \cdot \varphi(n) $.
